title: Kafka in German, 1912–1925: Betrachtung, Das Urteil, Der Heizer, Die Verwandlung, In der Strafkolonie, Ein Landarzt, Ein Hungerkünstler and Der Prozess, as transcriptions

license.payload: Public domain in the United States: every item was first published in 1930 or earlier, and every author died more than seventy years ago (Spinoza 1677, Leibniz 1716, Nietzsche 1900, Bergson 1941, Kafka 1924, Artaud 1948). Internet Archive scans of public-domain volumes; Project Gutenberg transcriptions under the Project Gutenberg License, whose header each file carries.
license.record: CC-BY-4.0 applies to this seat record only.

normalization: Internet Archive OCR text layers as fetched, uncorrected (text/<slug>.ocr.txt); the scan under original/<identifier>/ is the witness, and where the text layer misreads, the scan governs (the long s of the older type is read as f, and the loci that stand in OCR say so). Project Gutenberg transcriptions as fetched (text/<slug>.txt), with Project Gutenberg's header and licence, line endings normalized to LF; each is a transcription and is named as one. Every Internet Archive file checked against the md5 the Archive publishes, and every PDF opened.
units: one text layer per item, beside its scan where one is held

scope: Eight works as first published, each as Project Gutenberg's transcription of the edition its header names: Betrachtung (1912), Der Heizer (1913), Das Urteil (1916), Die Verwandlung (1917 printing), In der Strafkolonie (1919), Ein Landarzt (1919), Ein Hungerkünstler (in Die neue Rundschau, 1922) and Der Prozess (1925). QUEUED: scans of the first editions; Das Schloss (1926) and Amerika (1927); the volume Ein Hungerkünstler (1924); the letters and diaries as Brod first published them. The manuscripts, held by the Bodleian Library and the National Library of Israel, are under their terms.

why_seated: MANUS, 27 October 2026, after the twenty-sixth seating: "deleuze and guattari... no way around that copyright, huh?" Told that every route through it is closed for decades, and offered a declared absence for them and the open sources they read: "yes - i cant believe we havent seated spinoza yet. yes to all" — and "and leibniz' monodology only". Kafka is seated as the source of Deleuze and Guattari's Kafka: pour une littérature mineure (1975).
ruling: Seated in the language each wrote in, as far as the public domain of the United States reaches and an open witness was found, beside the declared absence of Deleuze and Guattari (27/07) (MANUS, 2026-10-27).
